mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.1%) compress equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, directly increasing present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260) and ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) triggers imminent monetary policy tightening, increasing equity risk premiums and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has a positive coefficient with p>0.05 in regression analysis.

mechanism_narrative: Synchronized growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1400) and retail sales (RSAFS > 500000) indicates accelerating consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue visibility, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 500000, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS > 142000) reflects expanding labor market conditions that increase disposable income and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.5 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100.5, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) - specifically when both exceed 3-month moving averages - creates a demand multiplier effect that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a negative coefficient with p>0.05 in regression analysis.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side recovery regime (INDPRO > 100 and GDPC1 > 18500), industrial output expansion supports manufacturing profit margins and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO > 100 and GDPC1 > 18500, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.
